#set text(font: "EB Garamond", size: 12pt, fill: rgb("#191b1e"))

#set par(justify: false, leading: 0.7475em, spacing: 1.15em)

    #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.55pt + lightgray)
  ]
  v(0pt)
}

#let subsection(title) = {
  v(5pt)

    #text(size: 12pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#title]

}

  block(breakable: not keep, width: 100%, below: 1.15em)[

      columns: (.85in, 1fr),
      column-gutter: 0.13in,
      text(size: 11pt, fill: gray)[#date],

}
